snippet.title: Commissioner BREAKS DOWN as Clark Fans BOYCOTT EMPTIES Pride Night Ticket Sales!
snippet.description:
Commissioner BREAKS DOWN as Clark Fans BOYCOTT EMPTIES Pride Night Ticket Sales!

Eight dollars. That is not a typo. That is not the price of a parking spot behind the arena. That is not the price of a hot dog that has been spinning since lunch. That is the price people were seeing for WNBA playoff tickets after Caitlin Clark and the Indiana Fever were gone. And that is where the whole thing gets ugly fast. Because for months, the league kept acting as if the Caitlin Clark effect belonged to everybody. The crowds, the ratings, the sold out arenas, the loud buildings, the national attention. They treated it as if the whole WNBA had suddenly become must see TV. Then Clark left the playoffs. And the ticket market fell through the floor.

But the part they really did not want people staring at was the empty seats. The Atlanta Dream played the New York Liberty in a semifinal game at State Farm Arena, a building that can hold more than seventeen thousand fans. This was not some random Tuesday game in the middle of the season. This was the playoffs. This was supposed to be one of the league’s biggest stages. The official attendance was around nine thousand seven hundred people. That means thousands of seats were missing from the party. The upper deck was dark. The black curtains were up. The building looked less like a playoff celebration and more like somebody forgot to invite half the city.

And here is the nasty little detail. When Caitlin Clark came to that same building earlier in the season, the place was packed. Over seventeen thousand fans showed up. Every section was open. The energy was loud. The building felt alive. Then the Fever were eliminated, and suddenly the same league was trying to sell playoff basketball for the price of a sandwich. That is not a small dip. That is a financial faceplant.
.
.
.
.
.

snippet.title: 휠체어 모자차, 독립적인 외출을 위한 맞춤형 이동수단
snippet.description:
이 휠체어 모자차는 거동이 불편한 분들을 위해 특별히 설계되었습니다. 모차는 전동 보조 본체로 차체 뒤쪽에 경사로 구조가 탑재되어 있어 휠체어를 힘들이지 않고 직접 밀어 올려 고정 플랫폼에 장착할 수 있습니다. 사용자는 휠체어에 앉은 상태로 경사로를 이용해 승하차하고, 휠체어를 고정한 뒤 본차를 운전해 더 먼 곳까지 이동할 수 있습니다.

차량은 전동 구동 방식으로 조작 핸들이 간단하고 조향이 부드러워 도로나 공원 길에서 안정적으로 주행합니다. 모자 결합 설계는 단거리 자유 이동과 장거리 외출을 동시에 해결하며, 기존 휠체어의 이동 거리 제한과 환승의 어려움을 개선했습니다. 휠체어에서 몸을 옮길 필요 없이 앉은 자세 그대로 이용할 수 있어 환승 시 체력 소모를 줄이고 부상 위험도 낮춥니다.

차체 프레임은 견고하며 보호 난간과 백미러가 장착되어 주행 시 시야 확보가 용이합니다. 목적지에 도착하면 잠금장치를 풀고 휠체어만 분리해서 따로 밀고 다닐 수 있습니다. 한 대로 두 가지 이동 모드를 활용해 장거리 주행과 현장 단거리 이동 모두 가능합니다. 장애인분들의 이동 제약을 허물어 혼자 외출하거나 통근, 야외 활동을 가능하게 해 생활 자율성을 높여줍니다.
#휠체어모자차 #장애인보조차 #배리어프리이동

snippet.title: CELTIC COLOURS LIVE - Celtic Cabaret
snippet.description: It’s Canadian Thanksgiving and the much-anticipated, first long weekend after summer has finally arrived—just in time for Cape Breton Island to start transforming into its stunning autumnal state. As the leaves begin to change from green to vivid hues of yellow, orange, and red, friends and family gather to share gratitude and thanks. And what better way is there to celebrate and give thanks than by making a night of it and heading out with pals for some music, dancing, and maybe a drink or two? If that’s your sort of thing. While this is technically the end of the Thanksgiving long weekend, it’s pretty hard to pretend that this isn’t going to be a great night of music well worth going out for—even if you do have to go back to work in the morning. Mi’kmaw drumming and singing group Sons of Membertou has been around for more than thirty years. They will open the show tonight with a welcome to their community and some traditional Mi’kmaw songs. The Voices of Ireland will have some songs to share as well, from the Irish and contemporary folk traditions. Liz Carroll and Jake Charron will provide the tunes, and Dawn and Helen MacDonald will join them for a few steps. All-in-all, not a bad way to top off Thanksgiving weekend at all.

snippet.description: Social Corazón 📍 Buenos Aires, Argentina Del grupo de Don Julio, esto fue de lo más recomendado y nuevo de todo lo que fuimos en el viaje. El lugar es una panadería y lugar de desayunos principalmente, pero en las tardes es de pastas y vinos, algo así. Lo que más me recomendaron fue ir a desayunar, pero la verdad yo no soy de desayuno, lo mío es la comida y la cena, por eso fuimos a echar pastas a las 1230pm que se siente todavía como desayuno. Pero el lugar estaba a reventar, la verdad estos cuates son unas pistolas para los restaurantes, todo en el lugar es perfecto, el servicio, cada detalle de los platos, las canastas de pan, los menús en forma de periódicos. Pero creo que las pastas y los desayunos son dos cosas que no me vuelven loco, y lo digo regresando de Italia jajaja pero gran lugar, se que mucha gente lo apreciará mucho más que yo. #argentina #buenosaires #comida #foodreviews
